briefs.explicit:
MISSION BRIEF L-000
Units: metres, seconds, kilograms. Time starts at t = 0 when every robot leaves its start location.

Locations (x, y, zone):
- base: (0, 0), outdoor
- warehouse roof: (12, 61), roof
- office roof: (-53, 4), roof
- control room: (-102, -13), indoor
- electrical room: (112, 81), indoor
- workshop: (-43, 79), indoor
- workcell West: (14, 114), indoor
- antenna mast: (86, 21), outdoor
- fuel depot: (10, -62), outdoor
- parking lot: (-149, 45), outdoor
- transformer pad: (92, 108), outdoor
- loading dock: (50, -111), outdoor

Robots:
- G1 (rover): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 3 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 29 kg), camera, thermal camera. Endurance: 4560 s, including the return to its start.
- D1 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 6.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg). Endurance: 1380 s, including the return to its start.
- A1 (fixed_arm): installed at workcell West and cannot move; it can only work on tasks located at workcell West. Equipment: robotic arm. Mains-powered (no endurance limit).
- M1 (mobile_manipulator): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 1.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 6 kg), robotic arm, camera. Endurance: 3300 s, including the return to its start.
- D2 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 9.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg), thermal camera. Endurance: 1500 s, including the return to its start.
- D3 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 8 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg). Endurance: 1440 s, including the return to its start.
- D4 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 7 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg), thermal camera. Endurance: 1320 s, including the return to its start.
- G2 (rover): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 2.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 15 kg), camera. Endurance: 5220 s, including the return to its start.

Tasks:
- T1: Inspect warehouse roof with a camera. Location: warehouse roof. Duration: 120 s. Needs: camera. Deadline: finished by t = 300 s.
- T2: Run a thermal scan of warehouse roof. Location: warehouse roof. Duration: 210 s. Needs: thermal camera.
- T3: Photograph parking lot for the condition report. Location: parking lot. Duration: 60 s. Needs: camera.
- T4: Inspect office roof with a camera. Location: office roof. Duration: 120 s. Needs: camera.
- T5: Collect a soil sample (2 kg) at transformer pad and keep it on board. Location: transformer pad. Duration: 90 s. Needs: robotic arm, cargo carrier (payload 2 kg).
- T6: Replace the filter cartridge at workcell West. Location: workcell West. Duration: 180 s. Needs: robotic arm.
- T7: Run a thermal scan of fuel depot. Location: fuel depot. Duration: 210 s. Needs: thermal camera. Deadline: finished by t = 480 s.
- T8: Deliver the pressure gauge (9 kg) to electrical room. Location: electrical room. Duration: 60 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 9 kg). Deadline: finished by t = 240 s.
- T9: Deliver the battery pack (13 kg) to control room. Location: control room. Duration: 60 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 13 kg). Deadline: finished by t = 420 s.
- T10: Run a thermal scan of antenna mast. Location: antenna mast. Duration: 180 s. Needs: thermal camera.
- T11: Collect a soil sample (3 kg) at parking lot and keep it on board. Location: parking lot. Duration: 120 s. Needs: robotic arm, cargo carrier (payload 3 kg).
- T12: Deliver the toolkit (4 kg) to electrical room. Location: electrical room. Duration: 60 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 4 kg).
- T13: Tighten the valve at workcell West. Location: workcell West. Duration: 210 s. Needs: robotic arm. Deadline: finished by t = 480 s.
- T14: Inspect warehouse roof with a camera. Location: warehouse roof. Duration: 90 s. Needs: camera.
- T15: Replace the filter cartridge at electrical room. Location: electrical room. Duration: 180 s. Needs: robotic arm. Can start only after T8 is finished.
- T16: Deliver the cable reel (5 kg) to loading dock. Location: loading dock. Duration: 60 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 5 kg).

Rules:
1. Every task is done by exactly one robot. A robot does its tasks one at a time, in the order you list them, travelling between task locations.
2. A robot can only do a task if it has the needed equipment, enough payload capacity, and can reach the task location.
3. A task that must start after another task waits until that task is finished, even if a different robot does it.
4. Each robot must be back at its start location before its endurance runs out.
5. Every task must be finished by t = 1200 s.

Objective: minimise the finish time of the last task (the makespan).
briefs.informal:
Here's what we need from the robots today.

Positions are in metres from the base at (0, 0). Drones fly straight and can't go indoors; ground robots follow the road grid (so they travel |dx| + |dy|) and can't get onto roofs. Everyone leaves their start spot at time zero.

Places: warehouse roof (12, 61, a rooftop); office roof (-53, 4, a rooftop); control room (-102, -13, indoors); electrical room (112, 81, indoors); workshop (-43, 79, indoors); workcell West (14, 114, indoors); antenna mast (86, 21, outside); fuel depot (10, -62, outside); parking lot (-149, 45, outside); transformer pad (92, 108, outside); loading dock (50, -111, outside).

The fleet: G1 is a rover parked at base that hauls up to 29 kg at 3 m/s and runs for 76 minutes including the drive back. It has a camera and a thermal camera. D1, a quadcopter waiting at base, carries a camera, cruises at 6.5 m/s, lifts up to 2 kg and has 23 minutes of flight time, return trip included. A1 is a robot arm bolted down in workcell West; it can't move but can work on jobs inside workcell West, and it runs on mains power. M1 is our mobile manipulator at base: gripper arm, camera, room for 6 kg, moves at 1.5 m/s and lasts 55 minutes including getting back. D2 is a quadcopter at base with a camera and a thermal camera; it flies at 9.5 m/s, can lift 2 kg, and its battery lasts 25 minutes including the flight home. D3 is a quadcopter at base with a camera; it flies at 8 m/s, can lift 2 kg, and its battery lasts 24 minutes including the flight home. D4 is a quadcopter at base with a camera and a thermal camera; it flies at 7 m/s, can lift 2 kg, and its battery lasts 22 minutes including the flight home. G2 is a rover parked at base that hauls up to 15 kg at 2.5 m/s and runs for 87 minutes including the drive back. It has a camera.

Jobs:
(T1) Do a visual check of warehouse roof - that takes 2 minutes on site and it has to be finished within the first 5 minutes.
(T2) Check warehouse roof for hot spots - that takes 3.5 minutes on site.
(T3) Document parking lot with pictures - that takes 1 minute on site.
(T4) Do a visual check of office roof - that takes 2 minutes on site.
(T5) Pick up a soil sample at transformer pad and keep it on board; it weighs 2 kg - that takes 1.5 minutes on site.
(T6) Change the filter at workcell West - that takes 3 minutes on site.
(T7) Do a heat check over fuel depot - that takes 3.5 minutes on site and it has to be finished within the first 8 minutes.
(T8) Electrical room needs the pressure gauge, which weighs 9 kg - that takes 1 minute on site and it has to be finished within the first 4 minutes.
(T9) Control room needs the battery pack, which weighs 13 kg - that takes 1 minute on site and it has to be finished within the first 7 minutes.
(T10) Do a heat check over antenna mast - that takes 3 minutes on site.
(T11) Pick up a soil sample at parking lot and keep it on board; it weighs 3 kg - that takes 2 minutes on site.
(T12) Electrical room needs the toolkit, which weighs 4 kg - that takes 1 minute on site.
(T13) Someone has to tighten the valve at workcell West - that takes 3.5 minutes on site and it has to be finished within the first 8 minutes.
(T14) Get eyes on warehouse roof and check the panels - that takes 1.5 minutes on site.
(T15) Change the filter at electrical room - that takes 3 minutes on site but only once the pressure gauge (T8) has arrived.
(T16) Get the cable reel (5 kg) over to loading dock - that takes 1 minute on site.

Everything has to be wrapped up within 20 minutes of the start, and the sooner the last job finishes, the better. Every robot has to make it back to where it started before its battery runs out.
